title: Croatian Tamarind Crumble
description: A sweet and tangy dessert featuring a Croatian twist on a classic crumble.
instructions: Mix together unique flour, crumbly oats, and a pinch of salt.
Add in croatian honey, tamarind paste, and mix until crumbly mixture forms.
In a separate bowl, mix together tamarind fruit and unsalted butter.
Transfer the fruit mixture to a baking dish and top with crumbly mixture.
Bake for 30-40 minutes or until the topping is golden brown.
Serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
